title: PR port triage result
description: A portability verdict and a self-consistent classification of source PR files. yes/partial requires at least one portable file; no requires concrete reasons and no portable files.

portability.description: Use yes or partial only when portableFiles contains at least one source-diff path. Use no only when no meaningful target behavior remains.

reasons.description: Required semantically for partial and no verdicts.

portableFiles.description: Source-diff files whose behavior should be translated. Must be non-empty for yes or partial and empty for no.

skippedFiles.description: Source-diff files intentionally not translated, each with an architectural reason.
